name: Dirty Cases
source:
Your vacation is interrupted by a special mission given by your dad: to investigate [b]Juliana[/b]'s involvement with drugs. In this intriguing adventure, you'll explore the city of Rushville, meeting [b]beautiful girls[/b] while searching for evidence and facing off against the meanest guys on the streets.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/CoyotteStudio]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你的假期被你父亲赋予的一项特殊任务打断：调查[b]朱莉安娜[/b]与毒品的关系。在这场有趣的冒险中，你将探索拉什维尔市，结识[b]美丽的女孩[/b]，同时寻找证据并与街上最卑鄙的家伙对峙。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/CoyotteStudio]Patreon[/url]]
